theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_sl_co_approx_differentiable
theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (G : Euclid P → Euclid P) (ψ : ℕ → Euclid d → Euclid P) (V Y : ℕ → Set (Euclid d)) (F : ℕ → Euclid d → ℝ), MeasurableSet M → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[d] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (ψ j)) → (∀ j, InjOn (ψ j) (V j)) → (∀ j, ∀ y ∈ V j, Injective (fderiv ℝ (ψ j) y)) → (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (F j)) → (∀ j, IsCompact (closure (Y j))) → (∀ j, closure (Y j) ⊆ V j) → (∀ j, MeasurableSet (ψ j '' Y j)) → (∀ j, ψ j '' Y j ⊆ M) → (∀ j, ∀ y ∈ Y j, f (ψ j y) = F j y) → (∀ j, ∀ y ∈ Y j, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt d M (ψ j y) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (ψ j) y : Euclid d →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P))) → (∀ j, ∀ y ∈ Y j, G (ψ j y) ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (ψ j) y : Euclid d →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) ∧ ∀ e : Euclid d, inner ℝ (G (ψ j y)) (fderiv ℝ (ψ j) y e) = fderiv ℝ (F j) y e) → μHE[d] (M \ ⋃ j, ψ j '' Y j) = 0 → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[d].restrict M), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt d M x (approxTangentPlane d M x) ∧ G x ∈ approxTangentPlane d M x ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => μHE[d] (M ∩ ball x r ∩ {y | ε * ‖y - x‖ < |f y - f x - inner ℝ (G x) (y - x)|}) / ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ d)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
